frozen_features.ABSOLUTE_XYZ: Measured public EE position before correction in robot base XYZ coordinates; Euclidean distance to four raw trained centroids.
frozen_features.SOURCE_RELATIVE_XYZ: Measured public EE XYZ minus source-only reconstructed all-applied canonical target XYZ; Euclidean distance to four source-normalized trained centroids.
frozen_features.PRIVILEGED_ORACLE: Diagnostic ceiling only: use simulator-set true ACK history; this policy is not deployable and must not enter selection training.

frozen_classifier: single nearest centroid by Euclidean distance among [00,01,10,11] in listed order, ties choose the earliest; prototypes pinned from previous original 4 reset clusters per morphology; NEVER recalibrate on new test seeds
native_recovery: for classified history, invert controller's documented signed per-axis target-relative root translation from predicted history's source-replayed target to all-applied source target, zero rotation; reject unrepresentable and malformed mapping
primary_endpoint: paired achieved EE XYZ distance in meters to source-reconstructed all-applied canonical goal after same recovery and eight zero native steps
secondary_endpoints: ACK history accuracy from public-observation-only classifiers on heldout seeds
per-reset paired XYZ-error difference vs absolute XYZ and NO_ACTION
private controller-target state used only as post-action audit
statistical_unit: Reset seed within fixed robot; four hidden histories and four policies within a seed are repeated factorial conditions not 16 independent reset clusters
preregistered_positive_gate: SOURCE_RELATIVE_XYZ should have lower mean achieved EE error than BOTH ABSOLUTE_XYZ and NO_ACTION in >=3 of 4 heldout reset seeds for EACH robot morphology; full descriptive effect and every failed seed mandatory. Do not interpret this as statistically significant from n=4.
fail_closed: Do not replace any holdout seed or remove any failed/collided case
No hidden true ACK or privileged controller target provided to either public classifier
Never use current test seed's observed data to alter frozen prototypes
No test-set threshold/feature selection after inspecting outcomes
No label-conditional selection in public policies; only PRIVILEGED_ORACLE permitted to access true history as ceiling
Do not claim actual autonomous PickCube success, hardware safety, or external peer adoption
4 holdout seeds per robot cannot support narrow population confidence intervals
Explicitly report if the prospective benefit threshold is not met
